  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Signup" name="Customer signup received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Service_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Signup" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Service_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Service_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Service_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Service_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_SubscriptionActivity" name="Wait for subscription activity" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Service_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToBillingDue</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToUpdatesDue</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCancellation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BillingDue" name="Billing cycle due">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToBillingDue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Billing_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalDefinition_BillingDue">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A billing cycle is due</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_BillingCycles" name="Run automated billing cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Billing_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Billing_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_UpdatesDue" name="Regular subscription communication due">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToUpdatesDue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Updates_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalDefinition_UpdatesDue">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A regular subscription communication is due</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send updates, product enhancements, or renewal notifications" messageRef="Message_SubscriptionUpdates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Updates_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Updates_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CancellationRequest" name="Cancellation request received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCancellation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancellation_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Cancellation" messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Support team processes cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancellation_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancellation_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustments" name="Are refunds or charges required under the terms?" default="Flow_NoAdjustments">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancellation_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentsRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdjustments</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyAdjustments" name="Apply applicable refunds or charges according to the terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentsRequired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentsToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentsMerge" name="Continue after terms-based adjustment decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentsToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdjustments</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancellation_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Support team deactivates subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancellation_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancellation_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancellation_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancellation_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SubscriptionClosed" name="Subscription deactivated and final balance settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancellation_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Signup" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionActivity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToBillingDue" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionActivity" targetRef="Event_BillingDue"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToUpdatesDue" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionActivity" targetRef="Event_UpdatesDue"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCancellation" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionActivity" targetRef="Event_CancellationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Billing_1" sourceRef="Event_BillingDue" targetRef="Task_BillingCycles"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Billing_2" sourceRef="Task_BillingCycles" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionActivity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_1" sourceRef="Event_UpdatesDue" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_2" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionActivity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_1" sourceRef="Event_CancellationRequest" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_2" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentsRequired" name="Adjustments required" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustments" targetRef="Task_ApplyAdjustments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Refunds or charges are required under the terms</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustments" name="No adjustments required" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustments" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentsToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyAdjustments" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_3" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsMerge" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_4" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_5" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_SubscriptionClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says an activity occurs repeatedly or continues over an ongoing process and separately states that another activity starts only when a condition occurs: do not model the ongoing activity as an unconditional predecessor of the condition-triggered activity; preserve their distinct timing and stated dependencies in the BPMN flow
rules.situation: the description says an activity occurs repeatedly or continues over an ongoing process and separately states that another activity starts only when a condition occurs

rules.instruction: When the description names an activity or outcome with multiple stated actions, alternatives, or a distinguishing object or participant.: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or event so its described scope remains identifiable. Preserve materially stated actions, alternatives, and objects or participants; do not substitute a broader or different action or add unsupported details.
rules.situation: the description assigns distinct actions to different actors or describes separate actions at different stages of a process.

rules.instruction: When the description says a process begins when a participant performs an identifiable action that establishes the process trigger: Model a start event for the trigger, followed by a separate task for the participant’s action; do not represent the action only as a start event.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant performs an identifiable action that initiates the process
